title: AI Review Intelligence
summary: Analyze Google and Yelp reviews to surface recurring themes, sentiment trends, and competitor benchmarks.
businessProblem: Business owners read reviews reactively but never systematically analyze patterns. Recurring complaints about wait times or staff go unnoticed until they show up in multiple 1-star reviews.
outcome: Weekly report showing: top praise themes, top complaint themes, sentiment trend vs. last month, and how your ratings compare to 3 nearby competitors.
expectedOutcomes: Weekly report showing: top praise themes, top complaint themes, sentiment trend vs. last month, and how your ratings compare to 3 nearby competitors.
whoItsFor: Local businesses with 20+ reviews across Google and Yelp who want operational insights from customer feedback, not just star ratings.
aiInputs: Your Google Business Profile reviews (last 90 days)
Competitor review samples from Yelp Fusion API
Business context: services offered, price range, location
aiOutputs: Theme clusters for praise and complaints with example quotes
Top 3 operational recommendations based on review patterns
noCodeTools: ChatGPT with pasted review exports (manual weekly)
Birdeye or Podium built-in sentiment dashboards
Google Sheets + manual review paste + GPT formula
lowCodeTools: n8n weekly pull from Google + Yelp → OpenAI analysis → email report
customBuildStack: Scheduled job pulling reviews via APIs
OpenAI for theme clustering and summarization
Report delivered via email or Notion page
implementationSteps: Connect Google Business Profile and Yelp Fusion APIs
Pull 90 days of reviews for your business and competitors
Run OpenAI analysis with structured output template
Deliver weekly report every Monday morning
Share complaint themes with operations team for action items
systemBehavior: Read-only — does not post responses (see Review Response Assistant)
Aggregates across platforms into unified theme view
Includes verbatim quotes as evidence for each theme
Flags new complaint themes not seen in prior reports
risks: Small review volumes produce unreliable theme clusters
Competitor benchmarking may use businesses that aren't true competitors
Yelp API terms restrict how review text can be stored and displayed
AI may over-index on recent negative reviews vs. long-term trends
